yandexBusiness.title: Connect Yandex.Business
yandexBusiness.whyCookiesBody: Yandex.Business doesn't have a public API for managing reviews and company info, so OneVoice works through your session — as if you'd opened the site yourself. Cookies are stored encrypted and only used by our RPA agent.

quote.label: Illustration
quote.body: In the morning — one inbox, not five tabs. OneVoice has already answered the simple questions; for the hard ones it asks for your sign-off.
quote.note: This is what a normal day can look like once all your channels are connected.

hero.body: Telegram, VK, Yandex.Business — all in one inbox. OneVoice drafts replies, prepares posts for every channel, and keeps reviews in plain sight while you focus on your work.

preview.composing: OneVoice is drafting a reply for Alena

belief.headlinePrefix: Small businesses don't lose because they do bad work. They lose because
belief.body: A coffee shop, a salon, a workshop — ten channels and one pair of hands. OneVoice doesn't replace you. It replies first so you have time to reply better.

features.headline: Four things you usually don't have time for.

0.title: Every channel in one list
0.body: Messages, reviews, and comments from Telegram, VK, and Yandex.Business land in a single stream. No tab-hopping, no forgotten threads.

1.title: A reply in seconds, yours in minutes
1.body: OneVoice knows your hours, menu, and tone. It prepares a draft. You send, tweak, or ask for another try.

2.title: One post — every channel at once
2.body: Write it once — it publishes everywhere, tuned for each platform's format. Schedule it for when your audience is reading.

3.title: Reviews under calm watch
3.body: Every review in plain sight. Low ratings rise to the top. High ones get a thank-you in your tone of voice.

howItWorks.headline: Three steps. Half an hour of your time.

0.title: Connect
0.body: Telegram, VK, Yandex.Business — one link at a time. No API keys, no fiddly settings.

1.title: Tell us
1.body: Share your menu, hours, and tone. OneVoice remembers and writes in your words.

2.title: Receive
2.body: Customer replies, posts across every channel, a reviews digest. You have the final word, always.
